new_scholarship.description: Swansea University International Excellence Scholarships are tuition-fee discounts of up to GBP 5,000 for the first year of study for overseas students who have demonstrated academic excellence or show potential to do so. Undergraduates who receive the full GBP 5,000 in year one can receive an additional GBP 2,000 in year two by achieving a minimum 70% average in year one.
new_scholarship.best_fit: An overseas applicant with an offer of an undergraduate place at Swansea for January or March 2027 entry who has a strong academic record.
new_scholarship.eligibility_summary: Overseas students with an offer of an undergraduate or postgraduate taught place at Swansea, applying through the scheme for their country of ordinary residence (China or Rest of the World) by 12:00 GMT on 27 November 2026.
